abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive time series of historical National Accounts for Scotland (onshore and offshore) from 1948 to 2018. It includes a detailed breakdown by income component and industrial sector using methods that are forward and backward compatible. Through this work we offer new insights on the performance of the post‐war Scottish economy, including its relative performance to the UK and its industrial makeup. Our findings also provide, for the first time, a full picture of the totality of Scotland's economy over the last 70 years by incorporating an estimate of North Sea oil and gas gross value added from within Scotland's territorial waters.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了苏格兰（陆上与海上）自1948年至2018年的历史国民账户综合时间序列数据。该序列按收入构成和产业部门进行了详细分解，采用的方法既向前兼容又向后兼容。通过这项工作，我们对战后苏格兰经济的表现提供了新的见解，包括其相对于英国的表现及其产业结构。我们的研究结果还首次通过纳入苏格兰领海内北海石油和天然气总增加值的估算，全面展示了苏格兰过去70年经济的整体面貌。
title: 70 years of Scottish National Accounts: 1948–2018

abstract: Building on economic theories of cultural transmission, we examine how audit partners’ cultural trust influences audit outcomes. Based on the “presumptive doubt” perspective of professional skepticism, we propose that audit partners from trusting cultures are more likely to rely on management’s assertions, while still exercising a high degree of caution and not naively trusting management. Consistent with our prediction, we find that audit partners from trusting cultures commit fewer Type I errors when issuing going concern opinions, without significantly increasing Type II errors. The reduction in Type I errors is primarily found when audit partners normally tend to be more conservative, and it is attenuated when management is less trustworthy. At the same time, audit partners from trusting cultures are also associated with more within-GAAP earnings management, suggesting that increased trust entails a cost. Collectively, our findings offer new insights into how cultural trust affects the assurance of accounting information.
abstract_zh: 基于文化传播的经济学理论，我们探讨了审计合伙人的文化信任如何影响审计结果。从职业怀疑的“推定怀疑”视角出发，我们提出，来自信任文化的审计合伙人更可能依赖管理层的陈述，同时仍保持高度谨慎，并非天真地信任管理层。与我们的预测一致，我们发现，来自信任文化的审计合伙人在出具持续经营意见时，犯第一类错误的概率较低，而并未显著增加第二类错误。第一类错误的减少主要出现在审计合伙人通常倾向于更为保守的情况下，并且在管理层可信度较低时，这一效应会减弱。同时，来自信任文化的审计合伙人也与更多的GAAP内盈余管理相关联，这表明增加的信任伴随着成本。总体而言，我们的发现为文化信任如何影响会计信息的保证提供了新的见解。
source_issue: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Volume 82, Issue 1
title: Audit partners’ cultural trust and audit outcomes
title_zh: 审计合伙人的文化信任与审计结果

abstract: Financial stress is correlated with behavioral biases thought to negatively affect quality of economic decision-making. To investigate whether this hypothesis holds for short-term (acute) financial stress, I conducted a lab-in-the-field experiment with vendors in neighborhood markets in Addis Ababa. Half of the vendors in the study were visited by a mystery shopper who made a single sizable purchase at their stalls, tripling vendors’ average daily earnings on that day but leaving their poverty status unchanged. Vendors who received this unanticipated earnings shock reported higher than expected earnings and an improvement in psychological well-being. However, the unanticipated increase in earnings did not translate into improved cognition or decision-making. Descriptive evidence shows that monthly shortfalls in earnings are more predictive of better-quality decision-making (as proxied by income-seeking behavior) than day-to-day variation in earnings.
abstract_zh: 财务压力与被认为会对经济决策质量产生负面影响的行为偏差相关联。为探究这一假设是否适用于短期（急性）财务压力情境，我在亚的斯亚贝巴社区市场对摊贩开展了一项实地实验。研究中，半数摊贩遭遇了一位神秘顾客，在其摊位进行了一次大额购买，使这些摊贩当日平均收入增至三倍，但并未改变其贫困状态。收到这一意外收入冲击的摊贩报告称，其收入高于预期，且心理健康状况有所改善。然而，这一意外收入增加并未转化为认知能力或决策质量的提升。描述性证据表明，月度收入短缺比日常收入波动更能预测更高质量的决策（以寻求收入行为作为代理指标）。
title: Short-Term Financial Stress and Decision-Making: Evidence from Market Vendors in Addis Ababa
title_zh: 短期财务压力与决策：来自亚的斯亚贝巴市场摊贩的证据

abstract: Based on the extensive correspondence of the sixteenth‐century merchant firm of Tucher, this article casts pre‐modern mercantile training in a new light. Rather than training for seven or more years with one master, including a possible sojourn abroad, apprentices served a string of short‐term contracts with masters across different European countries. This form of organization raised the cost of training significantly. I argue that participants bore these costs because apprenticeship served a purpose beyond the transmission of skills. The network‐based nature of trade meant that firms could expect to retain their investment in training through future business ties with the former apprentice. Over the course of the apprenticeship, reputation mechanisms served to vet the apprentice's suitability as a future trading partner. Under these circumstances, training became a club good. It facilitated network expansion and contributed to solving the fundamental problem of exchange.
abstract_zh: 基于十六世纪商人企业图赫尔家族的大量往来信函，本文重新审视了前现代商业培训。与单一师傅进行七年或更长时间的学徒训练（可能包括海外居留）不同，学徒们在不同欧洲国家的师傅之间签订一系列短期合同。这种组织形式显著提高了培训成本。我认为，参与者之所以承担这些成本，是因为学徒制除了技能传授之外，还服务于其他目的。贸易的网络性质意味着，企业可以通过与前学徒未来的商业联系，期望保留其培训投资。在学徒期间，声誉机制用于考察学徒作为未来贸易伙伴的适宜性。在此情况下，培训成为一种俱乐部产品，促进了网络扩展，并有助于解决交换的根本问题。
title: Training as a club good: Merchant apprenticeship in sixteenth‐century Europe
title_zh: 培训作为俱乐部产品：16世纪欧洲的商人学徒制

abstract: Abstract Economic studies on historical housing markets have gained increased popularity in recent years, yet remain limited by data scarcity. In this paper, a novel housing transaction dataset with more than 1000 observations from the historic Huizhou prefecture in south China is collected. This study develops housing price indices spanning the late Ming, Qing, and Republic of China eras (1570–1949). Results from hedonic ordinary and quantile regressions reveal unique housing price determinants tied to the region's cultural background: property orientation, proximity to ancestral halls and Buddhist temples, and seller's gender. Sellers being in urgent financial situations is positively correlated with the sales price.
abstract_zh: 关于历史住房市场的经济学研究近年来日益受到关注，但仍受限于数据稀缺。本文收集了来自中国南方历史徽州府超过1000条观测值的新型住房交易数据集。研究构建了跨越晚明、清代及民国时期（1570-1949年）的房价指数。通过特征价格普通回归与分位数回归的结果，揭示了与该地区文化背景紧密相关的独特房价决定因素：房产朝向、与祠堂及佛教寺庙的邻近程度，以及卖方性别。卖方处于紧急财务状况与销售价格呈正相关。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Long‐run housing price indices and determinants: New data from Huizhou, China, 1570–1949
title_zh: 长期房价指数及其决定因素：中国惠州的新数据（1570–1949）

abstract: We study a game in which universities compete by making unobservable investments in education quality. Subsequently, the graduates are considered for a single placement by an organization. A merit-based evaluator compares the realized skill of each graduate. A prestige-based evaluator only observes a noisy signal of the universities' relative education quality. Though a prestige-based evaluator does not know the true skills of the graduates, we derive conditions under which an increase in the probability of the prestige-based evaluator incentivizes higher investment and benefits the organization.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个博弈模型，其中大学通过进行不可观测的教育质量投资来竞争。随后，毕业生被一个组织考虑进行单一职位安置。基于能力的评估者会比较每位毕业生实际展现的技能。而基于声望的评估者仅能观察到大学相对教育质量的噪声信号。尽管基于声望的评估者不了解毕业生的真实技能，我们推导出条件，在这些条件下，增加基于声望评估者的概率会激励更高的投资，并使组织受益。
title: Evaluating University Graduates: Prestige Versus Merit
title_zh: 评估大学毕业生：声望与能力

abstract: We analyze a setting in which physicians, who differ in their degree of altruism, first exert diagnostic effort before deciding whether to administer a test to determine the most appropriate treatment. Diagnostic effort yields an imperfect private signal of the patient's type, whereas the test provides a more accurate assessment. Absent corrective transfers, physicians exert too little diagnostic effort and may rely excessively on testing. When altruism is either homogeneous or observable, the first-best allocation can be decentralized through a payment scheme consisting of (i) a pay-for-performance (P4P) component, based on the proportion of correctly treated patients, to induce the optimal diagnostic effort and (ii) a fixed component to ensure both the optimal testing decision and physician participation. When altruism is heterogeneous and privately known to physicians, the two-part tariff that decentralizes the first-best is no longer incentive compatible. The optimal contract is pooling rather than separating, an instance of nonresponsiveness. Its uniform P4P component induces more altruistic physicians to exert higher diagnostic effort, while the fixed component must be conditioned on diagnostic test costs to promote optimal testing decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个情境，其中利他主义程度不同的医生，首先付出诊断努力，然后决定是否进行测试以确定最合适的治疗方案。诊断努力产生关于患者类型的不完美私人信号，而测试则提供更准确的评估。在没有纠正性转移支付的情况下，医生付出的诊断努力过少，并可能过度依赖测试。当利他主义是同质的或可观察时，通过一种支付方案可以实现最优配置的分散化，该方案包括：（i）基于正确治疗患者比例的按绩效付费（P4P）组成部分，以诱导最优诊断努力；（ii）固定组成部分，以确保最优测试决策和医生参与。当利他主义是异质的且为医生私人所知时，分散化最优配置的两部定价不再具有激励相容性。最优合同是混同而非分离，这是非响应性的一个实例。其统一的P4P组成部分促使更具利他主义的医生付出更高的诊断努力，而固定组成部分则必须根据诊断测试成本进行调整，以促进最优测试决策。
title: Incentivizing Physicians' Diagnostic Effort and Testing With Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection
title_zh: 激励医生诊断努力与检测：道德风险与逆向选择

abstract: We examine the impact of working from home (WFH) practices on the financial services industry, focusing on sell-side equity analysts. We find that analysts who previously benefited from access to in-person interactions with other informed parties experience a greater decline in earnings forecast accuracy following the COVID lockdown and the shift to WFH. Notably, the informational advantage associated with the in-person access disappears during the lockdown and returns once restrictions are lifted. Our results are stronger for all-star analysts and analysts with shorter coverage periods, suggesting that all-star analysts rely relatively more on access to in-person interactions prelockdown and that accumulated firm-specific knowledge mitigates the loss of in-person interactions. Our results remain robust across alternative analyst performance measures. We conclude that, despite recent advances in communications technology, AI, and machine learning, in-person interactions remain a unique and difficult to substitute information channel for sell-side research providers and that WFH impedes information flows between market participants in capital markets. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04637 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Forecasting Earnings from Home
